sequence: Duo mesh1.45 develops after early RT/LG climbs(.80/1.10). DT_S misses2.40; RT fails to achieve LB_M access and the fitter wraps2.75.

concerns.label: planned_second_level_job_not_achieved
concerns.observed: RT is assigned the LB_M climb at 0.80 but at 1.50 requests[.47,-1.37] from[35.4,23.8] while LB_M is[37.3,26.2]. It never achieves that block before RB contact 2.75.
concerns.consequence: Local access remains available to a fitter; a causal loss in yards and a safe attainable alternative are not established.
concerns.alternative: A controlled departure and other traffic can delay access. No matched alternative proves an attainable block; RT/RB collision3.35 occurs after the initial loss.
concerns.demonstratedFact: Recorded planned LB_M job does not become an achieved LB_M block before the initial carrier contact; this is not by itself a demonstrated wrong decision or weak physics.
concerns.nextDiscriminant: Use this saved encounter to separate keeper security, departure route/request and moving backer access; require a safe attainable alternative before fixing it.

concerns.label: run_cue_while_receiver_tracking_request_returns
concerns.observed: Run belief and an actual acquired RB carrying=true picture coexist with man:X and an upfield/outward final movement request. At2.00 the achieved FS velocity still points inward; do not call this achieved retreat.
concerns.consequence: A transient request reversal delays/supports a concern about continuous run leverage; exact lost time, achievable alternative and effect on final yards are unmeasured.
concerns.alternative: Preserving an alley roof through a deep mesh can be legitimate. The observed request reversal, not the continued job label alone, needs adjudication. Rob/Wall techniques do fit run even while their recorded job label stays receiver-named.
concerns.demonstratedFact: Current ManCoverage only shortcuts to a personally marked carrying back before LOS; generic pursueIfLive waits until the acquired carrier is past LOS, and the X receiver can still be read as a vertical stem. The code branch is established; whole-play causal importance is not.
concerns.nextDiscriminant: One saved state preserving RNG/cues can compare coherent roof/run support with receiver tracking; preserve play-action and actual blocking/receiver danger before any correction.

preservedUsefulFootball.offense: Early releases and an evasive interior encounter remain visible; do not erase the runner win over DT_S.
preservedUsefulFootball.defense: LB_M gathers and finishes3.45. RT/RB collision3.35 is post-wrap and supplies no evidence of the initial cause.
